Amplitude speed run

Funnel Analysis

  1. Build the critical path with a clear conversion window
  2. Break down the largest drop by a useful property
  3. Open the dropped-off users in Microscope
Amplitude speed run

Session Replay

  1. Watch a session from the funnel drop-off
  2. Jump to the moment of friction
  3. Check whether the behavior suggests a testable explanation
Amplitude speed run

Journeys

  1. Start from the event before the funnel drop
  2. Compare Pathfinder and Journey Map
  3. Expand or exclude an event to test the explanation

Hands-on

The app already works

  1. Add, edit, complete, filter, delete, and share tasks
  2. Edit event names in the Instrumentation panel
  3. Watch every attempted event in the Activity panel
Your turn · 12 min
1

Choose events

  1. Read the eight user actions in the guide
  2. Choose the actions worth tracking and name each event
  3. Write one question each chosen event should answer
Done when

Every chosen action has one event name and one question it will answer.

Hands-on

The user actions

Adds a task
Marks a task complete
Marks a completed task active
Edits a task
Deletes a task
Changes the list filter
Copies a share link
Opens somebody else's shared list
Your turn · 12 min
2

Add properties

  1. Add context needed to answer each event question
  2. Define role, analytics experience, and workshop table as user properties
  3. Give every property a type and example value
Done when

Each event carries the context its question needs, and the user properties describe the person rather than the latest action.

Hands-on

Check each property

Use

A chart needs it

The property changes a filter, group, or interpretation.

Type

Its type is stable

Number stays number; boolean stays boolean.

Privacy

It avoids task text

Length can answer the question without collecting content.

Your turn · 8 min
3

Connect Amplitude

  1. Create a blank Amplitude project
  2. Copy its API key into the app connection panel
  3. Set your profile and send user properties
Done when

The app shows Connected and the Activity panel records an Identify call.

Hands-on

Connection details

  1. Use a project API key, never a secret key
  2. Use the generated analyst ID instead of an email address
  3. Choose US or EU to match the Amplitude project
Your turn · 12 min
4

Generate and verify events

  1. Perform at least three different actions in the app
  2. Compare the Activity payload with your tracking plan
  3. Find your user stream in Amplitude and inspect properties
Done when

At least three event types appear in Amplitude with the event and property names you planned.

Hands-on

When an event is missing

1App Activity response
→
2Browser network request
→
3Amplitude user stream

Find the first place the expected event disappears.

Your turn · 6 min · optional
5

Ask one question

  1. Choose one question from your plan
  2. Build a small Event Segmentation or Funnel chart
  3. Write down what your tiny workshop sample cannot tell you
Done when

A chart answers one question from your plan and its limitation is written down.

Close

Keep the question with the event

The app, guide, and reference plan stay available from the workshop hub.
